data.narrative:
Quantum-Systems is a Series D defense & security company founded by Florian Seibel, currently valued at $8.0B post-money on $1.2B raised. The comparable universe consists of 10 private peers and 2 public companies (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) in the same sector and stage, including Saronic ($9.2B), Chaos Industries ($4.5B), True Anomaly ($2.2B), and Onebrief ($2.1B).

Two valuation methods are applicable to this target. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.5x step-up multiplier typical of Series D advancement to the $8.0B last post-money valuation, yielding $12.0B. Peer-median benchmarking across the four same-stage, same-sector comparables produces a median of $3.4B, with a range spanning $2.1B to $9.2B. The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneous scaling trajectories within defense tech.

Triangulating these two methods produces a valuation range of $2.8B to $13.8B, with a median of $7.7B. The target's current $8.0B valuation sits near the triangulated midpoint, suggesting fair value within the derived range. The primary uncertainty stems from peer-set volatility; the spread between peer-median ($3.4B) and stage-progression ($12.0B) reflects material disagreement about capital efficiency and market positioning within the cohort. Materiality ultimately hinges on revenue scale, customer concentration, and technical defensibility relative to the peer set.
